grader: ran_rl.evaluation.evaluate --with-baseline (RAN RL SDK 1.2.9) on the team-hosted Maveric twin (http) in a SageMaker CPU job (t1/rl/job_evaluate.py); one item per SDK gate (SAFETY, SERVICE, UPLIFT, REPEAT, TRACE) plus COVERAGE; the run passes only if all six pass

config.description: team-hosted Maveric twin (staging guide 1.2.9), http backend; address and token not recorded

eval.items_rule: SAFETY, SERVICE, UPLIFT, REPEAT, TRACE from evaluation.json gates (pass is true); COVERAGE: aggregates.overall.coverage_mean of the model >= the baseline's, no tolerance; a gate with pass: null counts as NOT passed
eval.model_form: checkpoint: the SB3 .zip the SDK's CheckpointCallback saved during training, passed to evaluate --model as is (the SDK checksum is its sha256)
eval.target_first_declared: The target, the six items and the test set were first declared BEFORE training, in declared/t1.rl.train-20261103T023805Z-a09e.json (declared_at 2026-11-03T02:38:05.318Z); this declaration copies them unchanged. It is a new run id because the training declaration's code_sha (9b6a102) has no evaluation code and the runner refuses a job whose commit differs from its declaration; the training declaration's evaluation.where ('same run id') is superseded by this one.

evaluation.baseline: ran_rl RuleBasedController on the same seeds in the same job
evaluation.where: SageMaker CPU job (ml.c5.2xlarge) launched by tools/sm/run.py under THIS run id, t1/rl/job_evaluate.py; inputs: the SDK checkpoint .zip named in eval.checkpoint_uri and the training job's own packed project (identical configs, sha256-checked in the job)

items.COVERAGE: team item: model coverage_mean >= baseline coverage_mean (overall aggregate, no tolerance)
items.REPEAT: SDK gate: repeated run aggregates within 1% relative
items.SAFETY: SDK gate: no hard safety violations (non-finite actions) in any episode
items.SERVICE: SDK gate (cco): model sla_ratio_mean >= baseline sla_ratio_mean - 0.02
items.TRACE: SDK gate: checksum, config hash, scenario-set version, twin version and use case present
items.UPLIFT: SDK gate: model mean episode objective >= 1.05 x baseline mean episode objective

config.logging: httpx/httpcore loggers at WARNING and the job's stdout/stderr masked, so the twin host is not logged; the token is never logged
config.purpose: Track 1 RL unit, judging run 16: score the PPO policy trained in the lineage run against the SDK rule baseline on the fixed evaluation set
config.rl_code: t1/rl/reward_v1.py and t1/rl/official/prepare.sh at code_sha; project built by prepare.sh from the organiser starter outside git

runner.shipped: the committed tree at code_sha only (git archive); uncommitted changes never reach the job
